name: IBM uRaman-Dataset: peak-normalized Raman spectra of six MOF-74 metal-series samples in the nominal 1,000-2,000 cm^-1 window
description: Peak-normalized Raman spectra of the six MOF-74 metal-series samples of the deposit's MeMOF-74 set ('Me' = metal: Mg, Zn and the Zn75Mg25 alloy, plus the gold-coated Au@ variants), measured in the nominal 1,000-2,000 cm^-1 window with a WITec Alpha 300 RAS micro-Raman system (532 nm at 1 mW, 1800 g/mm grating, 200-400 accumulations x 0.5 s; the samples were provided by Prof. Carlos Basilio Pinheiro's group, per the deposit's About.md). Five files span 969.006-1,980.60 cm^-1 (1,600 points each); Au@Mg-MOF74 spans 860.797-1,887.76 cm^-1 (1,600 points), off the nominal window, so the common window is the intersection of the six native axes, resampled with linear interpolation onto 970-1,887 cm^-1 @1 cm^-1 (918 points). All six spectra are peak-normalized (max = 1.0) as deposited, with no negative points in this window. One spectrum per class (6 classes): a reference set, not CV-learnable. is_grouped=False. The 1,000-2,000 cm^-1 file of Au@Zn75Mg25-MOF74 is spelled with a double dash in the deposit ('Au@Zn75Mg25--MOF74.csv'); its label is normalized to a single dash. Served from the same commit-pinned codeload archive as uraman_mofs (commit 47e712d326fb0458ee8218ab73a2cfc269dcdfab, 819,336 bytes, size + sha256 pinned).

rai:dataCollection: Raman measurements of six MOF-74 metal-series samples in the nominal 1,000-2,000 cm^-1 window; WITec Alpha 300 RAS, 532 nm at 1 mW, 1800 g/mm grating, 200-400 accumulations x 0.5 s; samples provided by Prof. Carlos Basilio Pinheiro's group.
rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Peak normalization to max = 1.0 as deposited; the WITec exports of this window carry no background subtraction (all intensities >= 0). The loader linearly interpolates the native 1,600-point grids onto the common 970-1,887 cm^-1 @1 cm^-1 grid (918 points); no baseline correction, smoothing or other preprocessing is applied.
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Sample identities are given by the deposit's file and folder names (MOF-74 metal-series composition: Me = Mg, Zn, Zn75Mg25; Au@ = gold-coated variant); the labels are derived from the deposit's filenames, not re-curated for this benchmark. Note: the 1,000-2,000 cm^-1 file of Au@Zn75Mg25-MOF74 is spelled with a double dash in the deposit ('Au@Zn75Mg25--MOF74.csv'); the label is normalized to a single dash (matching the 70-3,000 cm^-1 file).
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: No personal or sensitive information is included. All samples are inorganic MOF-74 metal-series materials.
rai:dataBiases: Single facility (IBM) and single instrument (WITec Alpha 300 RAS, 532 nm, 1 mW). One stitched spectrum per sample, so there is no replicate structure and no within-class variance. The common window (970-1,887 cm^-1) is narrower than the nominal 1,000-2,000 cm^-1 acquisition window: every spectrum is truncated outside the common window (the five nominal-window files lose 1,888-1,980.60 cm^-1, Au@Mg-MOF74 loses 860.797-969 cm^-1), and the spectra are not directly comparable to the same materials measured in the other windows or at other excitation wavelengths (see the uraman_mofs and uraman_mof74_70_3000 keys).
rai:dataLimitations: One stitched spectrum per sample (6 samples) - a reference set, not a CV-learnable classification; single instrument/facility; every spectrum is truncated outside the common 970-1,887 cm^-1 window; peak normalization to 1.0 removes absolute intensity information; the excitation/power differs from the deposit's top-level set (532 nm at 1 mW here vs 532/633 nm at 1-2 mW there); the CDLA-Sharing-1.0 license is share-alike (commercial use allowed, derivative works must carry the same license).
rai:dataSocialImpact: Materials-science reference data for the MOF-74 metal series (candidate gas-sensing and CO2-capture materials); no human or medical use.
rai:dataUseCases: Reference spectra for spectral matching and few-shot / augmentation use; metal-series comparison (Mg vs Zn vs Zn75Mg25, gold-coated vs uncoated) on a common 1,000-2,000 cm^-1-style window; not suitable for CV-based classification (one spectrum per class).
prov:wasGeneratedBy: Data collection: Raman spectra of six MOF-74 metal-series samples (Mg-MOF74, Zn-MOF74, Zn75Mg25-MOF74 and the gold-coated Au@Mg-MOF74, Au@Zn-MOF74, Au@Zn75Mg25-MOF74) measured in the nominal 1,000-2,000 cm^-1 window with a WITec Alpha 300 RAS micro-Raman system (532 nm excitation, 1 mW, 1800 g/mm grating, 200-400 accumulations x 0.5 s); the samples were provided by Prof. Carlos Basilio Pinheiro's group (per the deposit's About.md). Part of IBM's uRaman-Dataset (commit 47e712d326fb0458ee8218ab73a2cfc269dcdfab, 2023-06-19, CDLA-Sharing-1.0, maintainer Matheus Esteves Ferreira); no indexed parent paper exists, so the repository is the citation. All spectra are peak-normalized (max = 1.0) as deposited. This raman_data key resamples the six native 1,600-point grids onto the common 970-1,887 cm^-1 @1 cm^-1 grid (918 points; the intersection of the six native axes: five files span 969.006-1,980.60 cm^-1, Au@Mg-MOF74 spans 860.797-1,887.76 cm^-1, off the nominal window).
